My girlfriend's into the "you can't feel a thing" experience and T-ZERO delivers exactly that. 0.01mm plus instant body-heat transfer genuinely feels like a second skin — the gap to "wearing nothing" is basically non-existent. I've tried 0.01mm brands from Japan, Korea, and Europe, and the hyaluronic lube stops the ultra-thin from drying out and tearing. The manufacturing is clearly a step up in maturity, and neither of us got any reaction.
